main_text.head: INDEX SECTIONUM
main_text.l: 14. Quænum mobilium aut immobilium venian̄ nomine?
main_text.head: SECT. IX. CAP. II.
main_text.l: 1. Quid si quis testetur in loco domicilii, adhibitis solemnibus loci, ubi res sita?
2. Quid si quis testetur secundum sui loci solemnia?
3. Quid si forensis secundum loci statutum testamentum condat, ubi tantum hospitatur?
4. Quid si in fraudem statuti, alibi testamentum condat?
5. Quid si forensis cum virgine matrimonium ineat, an contrahere censebitur, secundum statutum patriæ virginis?
6. Quid si de lucro dotis contentio, cujus loci spectandum erit statutum?
7. Quid si maritus domicilium transfulerit, an prioris an posterioris spectandum erit statutum?
8. Quid si statutum loquatur de hypothecâ, competenti uxori in mariti bonis?
9. Quid si de contractibus proprie dictis eorumque solemnibus contentio? Ubi & variæ exceptiones.
10. Quid si de contractus naturâ, deque iis, quæ eum comitantur, sit contentio?
12. Quis locus spectandus ratione effectus, seu complementi contractus?
13. Quid si alternative in plura loca destinata sit solutio?

page.notes: Scan is blurred and speckled; several words in the list are uncertain (e.g. "Quænum" in entry 14 and "venian̄" may be misread). The entry 14 line is printed twice in the page layout, once as the first line and once continuing "nomine?", which I have transcribed as printed. Entry 14 and the catchword are read from the same line at foot. Long s rendered as s throughout.
